CUSTOMER AWARENESS · QUICK ANSWERS

Common Questions & Solutions

A practical help centre for everyday app, device, account, connection and reseller questions. Start with the symptom, follow the suggested checks in order, and contact support if the issue continues.

🔐

Protect your account

Keep login details private. Never share passwords, one-time codes, payment card security codes or remote-access access with anyone.

📲

Install apps safely

Use official app stores or a download link verified by the app publisher. Check the app name, publisher, permissions and compatibility before installing.

🌐

Understand connection issues

Check your internet and device first. If a warning says access is restricted or a certificate is invalid, stop and contact the relevant provider rather than bypassing it.

💳

Make payments carefully

Confirm the package, price, currency and recipient before paying. Keep your receipt and never send banking passwords or one-time verification codes.

Browse the questions below.

1. App installation & device setup

Which app should I install?

Use only an app confirmed as compatible with your device and account by the service provider. Check the app name and publisher before installing. If unsure, ask support for the current verified instructions.

Where should I download the app?

Prefer the device's official app store or the app developer's verified website. Avoid random APK websites, shortened links from unknown senders and files shared in public groups.

The app will not install. What should I do?

Check that your device has enough free storage, a supported operating-system version and a stable internet connection. Restart the device and retry using the official installation instructions. Do not disable device security to force an installation.

What is the difference between an app and a subscription?

The app is the player installed on your device. A subscription or account is provided separately by the service you choose. Installing a player does not automatically create an account or guarantee access to content.

Can I use the same account on another device?

Only if your package and provider terms allow it. Ask support to confirm the permitted number of devices and any simultaneous-use limits before signing in elsewhere.

Why does the app ask for permissions?

Some permissions may support normal app functions, but only approve permissions that make sense for the app's purpose. If a permission request seems excessive or unexpected, cancel and verify it with the official developer.

2. Login, account & playlist problems

My login details are not working. How can I fix this?

Check spelling, capital letters, spaces and the selected login method. Confirm that the account is active and that you are using the latest details supplied by your provider. Never post credentials in a public chat.

The app says “account expired”. What does this mean?

The account may have reached its end date or may need a status check. Contact the provider with your order reference and registered username. Do not make a second payment until the account status is confirmed.

My playlist or channel list is empty. What should I check?

Confirm that the account is active, the correct profile or playlist is selected and the device has internet access. Close and reopen the app once. If the list remains empty, ask support to check the account configuration.

Why is the TV guide (EPG) missing?

The guide may not be included, may still be loading or may need an update within the app. Check the app's guide settings and refresh option. If it remains blank, ask the provider whether guide data is available for your account.

I changed my password or received new login details. What next?

Use the newest details from the provider, update them in the app and remove old saved entries if necessary. Keep the new credentials in a secure password manager.

Can I share my login with friends or family?

Do not share an account unless the package terms explicitly permit it. Sharing can expose your account and personal information and may cause access or device-limit problems.

3. Buffering, freezing & playback

Why does playback keep buffering?

Pause playback and check whether other devices are using the connection heavily. Restart your router and device if needed, move closer to the Wi-Fi router or use a reliable wired connection where supported. Run a speed test and contact your internet provider if the connection is unstable.

The picture freezes but the sound continues. What should I do?

Exit the stream, close and reopen the app, then restart the device if the issue continues. Check for app and device updates. If only one programme is affected, report its title and the time it happened to support.

I see “No signal” or a black screen. What does it mean?

Check the TV input, HDMI cable, device power and internet connection. Test another authorised app or programme to help identify whether the issue is with the device, connection or a specific stream.

Only one channel or programme is not playing. Is my device faulty?

Not necessarily. Test another available item. If other content works normally, report the specific title, channel name, date and time. This helps support identify whether the problem is limited to that item.

Playback works on mobile data but not on home Wi-Fi. Why?

This may point to a home-network or internet-provider issue. Restart your router, check for service notices and contact your internet provider if necessary. Follow their approved network settings; do not try to evade access restrictions.

Does a faster internet package always fix buffering?

No. Wi-Fi interference, router performance, congestion, device limits and service-side problems can also affect playback. Test the connection near the router and compare with a wired connection if available.

4. Updates, errors & security warnings

Should I update the app?

Install updates only from the official store or verified developer source. Read the update information and make sure the app is compatible with your device. Avoid update files sent by unknown contacts.

Should I clear the app cache?

If the app offers a clear-cache option, it may help with temporary files. Do not select “Clear data” or “Reset app” unless you know your login details and understand that saved settings may be removed.

I see a certificate, privacy or security warning. Can I continue?

No. Stop and do not enter passwords or payment information. Check the device date and time, confirm the address is correct and contact the website, app developer or network provider through an independently verified channel.

The app closes or restarts by itself. What should I do?

Check device storage, install official system updates, close unused apps and restart the device. If the problem repeats, note the device model, app version and approximate time, then contact support.

Should I turn off my firewall, antivirus or device security?

No. Do not disable security protection to make an app or website work. Ask the relevant app developer or network provider to explain the warning and provide a safe, approved solution.

What should I do if a website or app link looks suspicious?

Do not open it, install files or enter information. Verify the link through the official company website or a known support contact. Report suspicious messages and delete them.

5. Orders, payments & subscriptions

How do I confirm my order?

Ask for written confirmation showing the selected package, price, duration, payment status and any applicable terms. Keep your order reference and receipt.

My payment is pending. Should I pay again?

Do not pay again immediately. Check your bank or payment provider's transaction status and send support the transaction reference or a redacted receipt. Never share your banking password, full card details or one-time code.

I have been charged twice. What should I do?

Keep both transaction references, contact the seller and your payment provider, and request a review. Do not publish your full receipt or account details in a public group.

How can I check my renewal date?

Check your order confirmation or account information. If the date is unclear, ask support to confirm the expiry date in writing before purchasing a renewal.

Can I request a refund?

Check the terms shown at purchase and the consumer protections that apply in your location. Contact the seller with your order reference, purchase date and reason for the request. Keep all correspondence and payment records.

What information should I send when asking for payment support?

Provide your order reference, payment date, amount, currency and transaction reference. Hide account numbers, card numbers, addresses and other unnecessary personal information before sharing a receipt.

6. Reseller & customer support

What should a reseller confirm before placing an order?

Confirm the customer's selected package, price, duration, device requirements and applicable terms. Check that payment is received and keep a clear order record before requesting activation.

My reseller credit balance looks incorrect. What should I send?

Send your reseller ID or username, the top-up date, amount, transaction reference and a screenshot with sensitive details hidden. Ask support to reconcile the transaction before buying more credit.

Can I share my reseller panel login?

Do not share panel credentials unless the written reseller agreement expressly allows authorised team access. Use unique passwords and enable additional security options where available.

What details help support solve a technical issue quickly?

Send the device model, app name and version, the exact error message, when it started, whether other apps work, and the troubleshooting steps already tried. Include screenshots only after hiding personal details.

How should I report a service-wide issue?

Report the time the issue began, the affected app or device types, the exact message and whether it affects one or multiple accounts. Avoid repeatedly reinstalling apps or changing settings while an investigation is underway.

How should resellers handle complaints?

Stay polite, acknowledge the issue, avoid promising a fix time you cannot confirm and provide the support ticket reference. Keep the customer updated when verified information is available.

Before contacting support

Prepare the app name, device model, exact error message, time the issue occurred and the steps you have already tried. For payment queries, include only the order and transaction references needed for investigation.

Never send: your bank password, full card number, card security code, one-time passcode, email password or remote-access code.

Frequently asked IPTV questions

Showing 25 help topics

What is IPTV?

IPTV delivers television content over an internet connection. Use only services and content you are legally authorised to access.

What do I need before setup?

A compatible device, reliable internet, an authorised subscription, a compatible player and the connection details supplied by your provider.

Which app should I use?

Choose an app compatible with your device and recommended by your authorised provider. Download it from an official app store or verified developer website.

Where can I find my login details?

Check the welcome message or account portal from your provider. Keep your credentials private.

What is a portal URL?

It is the connection address supplied by your provider for a compatible player. Copy it exactly as provided.

Why does login fail?

Check spelling, spaces, login method and account status. If it still fails, contact your provider privately.

Why is my channel list empty?

Refresh the playlist, check your account details and confirm the provider has assigned the correct package.

Why is playback buffering?

Pause other heavy downloads, restart your router and device, try Ethernet where possible, and test your internet connection.

Why does the app show no signal?

Check the device's internet connection, restart the app, verify account status and look for an official service notice.

Why does the app freeze?

Close unused apps, restart the device, check storage and update the player from its official source.

How do I restart Fire TV?

Open Settings → My Fire TV → Restart. Menu names may vary by device version.

How do I clear app cache?

On many Fire TV devices: Settings → Applications → Manage Installed Applications → select the app → Clear cache.

Should I clear app data?

Only as a last resort. It may remove saved logins, playlists and preferences.

How do I update an app safely?

Use the official app store or verified developer page. Avoid unknown APK mirrors and unexpected file links.

Can I use one account on multiple devices?

Only if your subscription terms allow it. Confirm the device limit with your provider.

Can I use the service while travelling?

Availability depends on licensing, provider terms and local law. Check before travelling; do not bypass geographic restrictions.

Why is the EPG empty?

Check that the guide is enabled, refresh guide data and ask your provider whether compatible guide information is available.

Why is catch-up unavailable?

Catch-up depends on channel support, provider settings and the permitted replay period.

Do I need a VPN?

Do not assume one is required. Follow provider terms and local law; ask your provider or internet provider about connection issues.

Are all apps compatible with every TV?

No. Compatibility depends on the TV operating system, app version, hardware and region.

How do I protect my account?

Use a unique password, keep it private, install trusted updates and report unfamiliar account activity.

What should I send support?

Share your device model, app name and version, exact error and time of issue. Never send passwords or payment-card details.

How can I check an app download is safe?

Prefer official stores and verified developer links. Check the publisher and requested permissions.

What should I do during an outage?

Check official service announcements, avoid repeated factory resets and contact support with the exact error.

Can any provider guarantee zero interruptions?

No internet service can guarantee zero interruptions. Performance depends on your device, home network, internet provider and service.

Still need help?

Send support your device model, app name and exact error message. Do not include passwords or payment details.

Common UK customer questions

Search by ISP name or problem, such as Sky, BT, Virgin Media, buffering, Wi-Fi, timeout or security warning.

My service is not loading on Sky Broadband. What should I check?

First confirm other websites work on the same device. Restart the streaming device and router, check the provider's official service notice, and confirm your account is active. If only one service is affected, ask the service provider for help. Do not change settings to evade network restrictions.

My app is not working on BT Broadband.

Check whether other apps and websites work. Restart your device and router, update the app from its official source, and verify your account details. If the issue affects only one service, contact its provider and BT if your wider connection is unstable.

I use Virgin Media and playback keeps stopping.

Check the Virgin Media connection status, test another device, pause large downloads, and try a wired Ethernet connection. Restart your router using the manufacturer's or Virgin Media's instructions. If multiple services are affected, contact Virgin Media.

My service works on mobile data but not my home Wi-Fi.

This can point to a home-network or provider-side issue, but it does not prove the cause. Restart the router and device, check for service notices, and contact your internet provider and service provider with the time and error details. Do not use a VPN or proxy to bypass a block.

Is there a Sky, BT or Virgin Media outage in my area?

Check the official service-status page or app for your broadband provider. If an outage is listed, follow its advice and wait for the provider's update. If no outage is listed, run the provider's connection test.

My UK broadband is slow in the evening.

Run a speed test using your provider's recommended tool, preferably near the router or over Ethernet. Pause large downloads, check how many devices are using the connection, and compare results at different times. Share the results with your ISP if speeds remain below your package expectations.

How do I check whether my Wi-Fi signal is weak?

Move closer to the router and test again. Keep the router in an open central position, away from thick walls and interference. If possible, test with Ethernet to separate Wi-Fi problems from broadband problems.

Should I change DNS settings to fix a UK ISP issue?

Do not change DNS as a way to bypass an ISP restriction or access controls. For ordinary connection faults, use your ISP's recommended automatic settings or ask its support team before changing network configuration.

Should I turn off IPv6 or router security?

Do not disable IPv6, firewall protections, parental controls or other security features just to make a service work. These settings protect your network. Ask your ISP or device manufacturer for safe, service-specific troubleshooting.

A warning or access-block page appears. What should I do?

Read the notice and do not try to work around it. Check whether the notice is from your ISP, the website or the app. Contact the named provider through its official support channel and use only services and content you are authorised to access.

My UK app shows a certificate or security warning.

Stop and do not enter passwords or payment details. Check the device date and time, update the app from its official source, and confirm the website address with your provider. If the warning remains, contact the app developer or service provider.

The app says connection timed out.

Check whether the device can open other websites, restart the app, confirm the account is active and check for a provider service notice. Record the exact time and error. If the broadband itself is failing, contact your ISP.

How can I tell whether the problem is my device or broadband?

Test another trusted app or website on the same device, then test the same connection on another device. If several devices have trouble, investigate the router or ISP. If only one app fails, contact that app or service provider.

What information should UK customers send to support?

Send your broadband provider name (for example Sky, BT, Virgin Media or TalkTalk), device model, app version, approximate time of the problem and exact error message. Never send passwords, full payment details or one-time security codes.

Can GTV ULTRA guarantee compatibility with every UK ISP?

No. Compatibility and performance can vary with the device, home network, broadband provider and service terms. Use supported apps and authorised services, and contact your ISP about general connection faults.

Common UK reseller questions and solutions

Find practical steps for everyday reseller problems. Search by keyword such as payment, credits, renewal, refund, panel, customer complaint or security.

A customer says their subscription has not arrived. What should I do?

Check your order record and payment status first. Confirm the customer's email or username, product, start date and order reference. If payment is confirmed but access has not been issued, raise a support ticket through the authorised provider channel. Never send another customer's account details.

A customer paid but the payment is pending.

Do not issue duplicate access or ask the customer to pay again immediately. Check the payment provider's transaction status, ask the customer for the transaction reference (not card details), and wait for the provider's confirmed result. Escalate if it remains pending.

A customer says they were charged twice.

Compare the order ledger with the payment provider's transaction records. Do not promise a refund before checking the payment status. If two settled charges are confirmed, follow your published refund process and keep the customer updated in writing.

How do I handle a refund request in the UK?

Check the order date, product terms and the reason for the request. Apply your published policy and applicable UK consumer law. Keep a written record of the request and decision. Do not make blanket statements that remove statutory consumer rights.

A customer says their subscription expired early.

Check the activation date, selected duration, account identifier and payment record. Compare these with the provider's authorised account records. If there is a genuine discrepancy, escalate it with the order reference and avoid sharing credentials in public chat.

A customer cannot log in after changing device.

Confirm that the subscription permits the new device and that the customer is using the correct app and login method. Check for typing errors and account status. Do not advise sharing accounts beyond the agreed device limit.

A customer asks to use one subscription in several homes.

Check the written subscription terms and device or household limits. Explain the permitted use clearly and offer an appropriate authorised plan if one exists. Do not encourage credential sharing that breaches the service terms.

My reseller panel login is not working.

Use the official panel URL saved by your organisation, check the username and password, and confirm your account is active. Use the official password-reset route or contact the panel administrator. Never send passwords or one-time codes to support.

I have run out of reseller credits.

Review the panel balance and your own sales ledger. Check whether any recent orders are still pending. Purchase or request additional credits only through the provider's verified payment process, and save the receipt and transaction reference.

The credit balance does not match my sales records.

Export or record the current balance, list each order and credit deduction by date, and compare them one by one. Check for cancelled, renewed or duplicate orders. Send the discrepancy and relevant order references to the panel administrator without including customer passwords.

A customer has the wrong package or duration.

Check the original order confirmation and the package selected at activation. If the issued package differs, stop making changes until the order is verified, then request a correction through the authorised provider process.

How should I manage renewals?

Keep a renewal register with customer reference, expiry date, plan and reminder status. Send a clear reminder before expiry, confirm payment, then process the renewal through the authorised panel. Do not promise automatic renewal unless it is actually enabled and disclosed.

A customer wants to cancel.

Confirm the account or order reference privately, explain the cancellation steps and any applicable terms, and record the date of the request. Stop future billing where required and provide written confirmation when cancellation is complete.

A customer reports buffering or playback problems.

Ask which device and app they use, the exact error, when it happens and whether other internet services work. Suggest ordinary device and home-network checks. If the issue appears service-side, send the case to authorised technical support. Do not provide instructions to evade ISP restrictions.

Several customers report the same issue at once.

Record the start time, affected app or service, device types and exact errors. Check official service announcements and contact the authorised provider's support channel. Send one concise incident report and share verified updates only; do not speculate about causes.

A customer says an app download link is unsafe or unavailable.

Do not send an alternative file from an unknown source. Verify the app publisher and download address using the official app store or developer website. If the link is no longer valid, remove it from your customer instructions until it is verified.

How do I protect customer information?

Collect only the information needed to support the order. Restrict panel access to authorised staff, use unique passwords and multi-factor authentication where available, and never store card security codes or share customer credentials in group chats.

A customer asks for a payment method I do not support.

Explain which payment methods your business officially accepts. Do not use an unknown third-party payment broker or ask for banking passwords, one-time codes or full card details. Provide a proper receipt for confirmed payments.

How should I advertise to UK customers?

Describe only services and content you are legally authorised to sell. Use accurate pricing, clear terms, transparent renewal and refund information, and avoid unsupported claims about channels, uptime or compatibility. Check UK advertising and consumer-protection requirements.

A reseller wants to share my panel login.

Follow your written reseller agreement and security policy. Give each authorised reseller their own named access if the platform supports it. Do not share a master administrator password or allow unapproved access.

A customer disputes what was included in their plan.

Refer to the product description and order confirmation shown at the time of purchase. Explain inclusions, device limits, duration and any exclusions in plain language. Correct misleading information promptly and keep a record of the resolution.

How do I handle a complaint professionally?

Acknowledge the complaint, repeat the issue to confirm understanding, give a realistic response timeframe, investigate using order records, and send a written outcome. Keep communication respectful and retain the complaint record.

What should I include in a support ticket?

Include reseller ID or business reference, order reference, date and time, app and device, exact error, and steps already tried. Remove passwords, payment-card details, one-time codes and unrelated customer data.

How do I close a reseller account safely?

Review outstanding orders, customer support obligations, balances and any contractual notice requirements. Export permitted business records securely, revoke staff access, rotate shared credentials and obtain written confirmation from the provider.

Complete Reseller Guidelines

A simple handbook to help resellers run their business professionally, look after customers and keep accounts secure.

Important: These are general business guidelines. Follow your signed reseller agreement, applicable UK law, payment-provider rules and data-protection duties. Only sell services and content you are authorised to provide.
01

Be honest with every customer

Explain exactly what your business provides. Do not promise channels, features, device support or service availability unless you have checked them.

02

Use clear prices

Tell customers the full price, subscription length, renewal cost and any extra charges before they pay.

03

Explain the service terms first

Make device limits, household limits, cancellation terms and any restrictions clear before taking an order.

04

Sell only authorised services

Only offer content and services you have permission to sell. Follow the law and the provider's reseller agreement.

05

Keep each order organised

Record the order date, customer reference, plan, duration, payment status and support status securely.

06

Check payment before activation

Use your official payment provider or business records. Do not rely only on a screenshot as proof of payment.

07

Give a receipt or confirmation

Send a clear confirmation showing what was purchased, the amount paid and the order reference.

08

Never ask for private banking information

Do not ask for bank passwords, card security codes, one-time passcodes or remote access to a customer's phone or computer.

09

Protect customer details

Only collect information you need. Do not post names, phone numbers, passwords or account details in public groups.

10

Keep your reseller panel secure

Use a unique password and multi-factor authentication if available. Do not share your master panel login.

11

Use support tickets properly

Include the order reference, device, app, error message and time of the problem. Never include passwords.

12

Do not guess when there is a fault

Check official service notices and ask authorised support. Give customers confirmed updates only.

13

Handle complaints politely

Listen, confirm the problem, explain the next step and give a realistic update time.

14

Follow refund and cancellation rules

Apply your published policy and relevant consumer law. Do not delay or misrepresent a customer's legal rights.

15

Manage renewals fairly

Send reminders before expiry. Do not renew or charge a customer without proper authorisation.

16

Do not pressure customers

Give customers time to read the terms and decide. Avoid false urgency or misleading discounts.

17

Keep business and personal accounts separate

Use business records and approved payment channels. Reconcile sales and credit balances regularly.

18

Train anyone who helps you

Give staff clear instructions on privacy, payments, customer service and account security. Remove access when they leave.

19

Check app downloads carefully

Direct customers to official app stores or verified developer pages. Do not send unknown files.

20

Review your advertising

Use accurate descriptions and genuine offers. Do not use fake reviews, fake customer numbers or unsupported guarantees.

HELP LIBRARY · QUICK ANSWERS

Popular streaming app questions & fixes

Search for the message on your screen, then follow the simple steps. Menu names can differ slightly between device models.

Browse all help topics below.

🌐 Internet & Wi-Fi📲 App problems ▶️ Playback & channels🔐 Login & account 📺 Device help🛡️ Safety
INTERNET & WI-FI

Why does my stream keep buffering or freezing?

  1. Check whether other apps and websites work on the same device.
  2. Pause downloads, cloud backups and other heavy internet use in your home.
  3. Restart your streaming device and your router. Turn the router off at the power for about 30 seconds, then allow it to reconnect fully.
  4. If possible, test with an Ethernet cable or move the device closer to the router.
  5. Close unused apps and check that your device has free storage and current software.
  6. Try another programme. If only one item has a problem, report its name and the time it happened.

Important: A speed-test result alone cannot guarantee smooth playback. Wi-Fi interference, household usage, device performance and the source service can all affect streaming.

INTERNET & WI-FI

My screen says “No Signal” or “No Internet”

  1. Check that the TV is on the correct HDMI input if you use a Fire TV Stick or TV box.
  2. Open the device network settings and confirm it is connected to your home Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
  3. Open a trusted website or another streaming app to test the internet.
  4. Restart the router and streaming device, then try again.
  5. If the internet works elsewhere but the app still shows an error, note the exact message and contact the app or service provider.

“No Signal” on the television itself can mean the wrong HDMI source or a loose cable; it does not always mean the internet is down.

APP PROBLEMS

The app crashes, closes or stays on the loading screen

  1. Exit the app completely and open it again.
  2. Restart the TV, Fire TV Stick or Android device.
  3. Check for app and device software updates from the official app store or device settings.
  4. On supported devices, open Settings → Apps → the app → Clear cache.
  5. Try again. If the issue remains, contact support before reinstalling or clearing app data.

Before choosing Clear Data: it may remove saved settings and sign-in details. Make sure you have the correct account information first.

PLAYBACK & CHANNELS

I can hear sound but the screen is black

  1. Try a different item to see whether the issue affects one programme or everything.
  2. Exit and reopen the player app.
  3. Restart the streaming device and check the HDMI cable and TV input.
  4. Check that the device and TV software are up to date.
  5. If the issue happens only with one item, send support its title and the time you tested it.
PLAYBACK & CHANNELS

One channel or programme is not playing

  1. Try a different channel or programme.
  2. Close and reopen the app, then test the original item again.
  3. Check whether the issue occurs on another device on the same home network, if available.
  4. Record the channel or programme name, the error message and the time of the test.
  5. Contact the authorised service provider if the issue continues.

If many unrelated items fail at the same time while other internet services work, the issue may be with the app or service rather than your home Wi-Fi.

PLAYBACK & CHANNELS

Why is the TV Guide (EPG) empty or showing the wrong time?

  1. Check the date, time and time-zone settings on your TV or streaming device.
  2. Close and reopen the app.
  3. Use the app’s own refresh or update-guide option if it provides one.
  4. Allow time for guide information to load, then check again.
  5. If only some entries are missing or incorrect, send support the channel name and the affected programme time.
LOGIN & ACCOUNT

My username or password is not accepted

  1. Check for typing mistakes, extra spaces and incorrect capital letters.
  2. Make sure you are using the correct login details for the app or service you were given.
  3. Check that you have selected the correct connection method in the app.
  4. Do not repeatedly guess passwords or share your credentials in public groups.
  5. Contact the provider privately and include the exact error message. Never send your password or one-time security code.
LOGIN & ACCOUNT

The app says my account or subscription has expired

  1. Check the confirmation or account information supplied by your service provider.
  2. Check that the device date and time are correct.
  3. Sign out and back in only if you have the correct details available.
  4. Contact the provider privately to confirm account status and any renewal details.

Installing a media-player app does not itself provide a subscription or access to content. Use only services and content you are authorised to access.

PLAYBACK & CHANNELS

Movies or series will not start, or subtitles are missing

  1. Test another title to check whether the problem affects one item.
  2. Close and reopen the app, then try again.
  3. Check the player’s audio and subtitle menu; not every title includes every language or subtitle track.
  4. Check for app updates and restart your device.
  5. Send support the title, season/episode (if relevant), device model and exact error message.
DEVICE HELP

My Fire TV or TV box remote is not responding

  1. Replace or recharge the batteries and check their direction.
  2. Make sure nothing blocks the device or remote sensor.
  3. Restart the streaming device.
  4. Follow the device manufacturer’s official pairing instructions for your remote model.
  5. If only the TV volume or power buttons fail, check the TV/remote equipment-control settings.
DEVICE HELP

My device is slow or says storage is full

  1. Restart the device.
  2. Uninstall apps you no longer use.
  3. Use the device settings to review storage and remove files you recognise and no longer need.
  4. Clear the cache of an affected app where the device provides that option.
  5. Install available system updates and avoid factory resetting unless the device manufacturer or support team advises it.
SAFETY & SECURITY

I see a security, certificate or “connection is not private” warning

  1. Stop and read the warning. Do not enter passwords or payment details.
  2. Check that your device date and time are correct.
  3. Close the page and open the service using a trusted, previously verified address.
  4. Contact the official website or service provider through a known support channel.
  5. Do not install unknown certificates, profiles, VPNs or remote-access apps to dismiss a warning.

  • The app name and version, if you can see it

  • When the problem started and what you have already tried

Please do not send: passwords, payment card details, one-time codes or other private security information.

QUICK ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions

Short answers to common setup and app questions.

What is an IPTV or media-player app?

A media-player app is software used to play compatible media. The app itself may not include channels, films, subscriptions or content. Access depends on a separate authorised provider and its terms.

Does installing an app give me a subscription?

No. Installing a player does not automatically provide a subscription or content. Check the app publisher and service provider information before paying for anything.

Should I clear cache or clear data?

Try Clear Cache first where available. Clear Data can reset the app, remove preferences and sign you out, so use it only when you know how to set the app up again.

Will restarting my router delete my Wi-Fi settings?

A normal power restart should not erase saved settings. Avoid pressing the router’s factory-reset button unless your internet provider instructs you to do so.

Why does the TV guide show the wrong time?

Check your device date, time and time-zone settings first. The guide information itself may also be incomplete or supplied by the content provider.

Can I use the same app on every television?

Not always. App availability and compatibility depend on the TV operating system, model and app publisher. Check the compatibility section and the official app store for your device.

What should I do if an app asks me to install an unknown file?

Stop and verify the source. Prefer the device’s official app store or a download link published by the app developer. Do not install files sent by unknown accounts.

Why does the same app work on one device but not another?

Devices can differ in software version, available memory, Wi-Fi reception, supported formats and app compatibility. Compare the devices and update the one experiencing the problem.

UK CUSTOMER GUIDES

Streaming app setup and troubleshooting in the UK

Simple, practical instructions for common home TV and streaming-device problems. Device menus vary by model and software version.

🔥

Amazon Fire TV Stick setup help

Use the official Amazon app store or a verified app publisher download. Keep your Fire TV software updated and check available storage before installing.

  1. Connect the Fire TV Stick to your TV's HDMI port and power adapter.
  2. Select the matching HDMI input on your television.
  3. Connect to your home Wi-Fi from Settings → Network.
  4. Install a compatible app from a trusted source and follow the app publisher's instructions.
  5. Restart the device if the app does not open after installation.

Only install applications you trust. Avoid unknown APK files and instructions asking you to disable device security protections.

📺

Android TV and Google TV help

Android TV and Google TV devices can have different app availability depending on the manufacturer, model and operating-system version.

  1. Open Settings and check the device's system update section.
  2. Confirm the device is connected to the internet.
  3. Use the Google Play Store to find compatible applications.
  4. Open Settings → Apps to force stop an unresponsive app or clear its cache where available.
  5. Restart the device and test again.
🖥️

Samsung and LG Smart TV compatibility

Not every Android application is available for Samsung Tizen or LG webOS televisions. Check the TV's official app store and the app developer's compatibility information.

  1. Find your television model in Settings → Support or About This TV.
  2. Open the television's official app store.
  3. Search for the app by its exact publisher name.
  4. If it is not listed, do not assume an Android APK will work on the TV.
  5. Ask the app developer which devices are supported.
🌐

Home broadband and Wi-Fi checks

Streaming quality depends on the broadband connection, Wi-Fi signal, device performance and the service being accessed.

  1. Check whether other websites and apps work on the same device.
  2. Pause large downloads, cloud backups and other heavy home-network activity.
  3. Move the device closer to the router or test a wired Ethernet connection if supported.
  4. Restart the router using its normal power procedure; do not factory reset it.
  5. Contact your broadband provider if multiple devices cannot access the internet.
🔊

Picture, sound and HDMI problems

Black screens, missing audio and “No Signal” messages can be caused by the TV input, HDMI connection, device settings or an individual media item.

  1. Confirm the TV is set to the correct HDMI source.
  2. Check that the HDMI cable or streaming stick is firmly connected.
  3. Test another app or programme to narrow down the issue.
  4. Check TV volume, mute and audio-output settings.
  5. Restart the TV and connected device.
🛡️

Security warnings and connection errors

If a browser or app shows a certificate, privacy or security warning, stop and verify the address before continuing.

  1. Do not enter passwords or payment details while a warning is displayed.
  2. Check your device date, time and time zone.
  3. Use a previously verified official website or app publisher source.
  4. Contact the service provider through a known support channel.
  5. Never install unknown certificates or remote-access software to dismiss a warning.

App and service are different

A media-player app is software. Installing a player does not automatically provide a subscription, channels or media content. Access depends on a separate provider and its terms.

Use authorised content and apps

Only use applications, services and media that you are authorised to access. Follow the app publisher's terms, your provider's agreement and applicable UK law.

UK CUSTOMER FAQ

Common questions from UK customers

Quick answers to common app, device and home-network questions.

Why does my Fire TV Stick keep buffering?

Check Wi-Fi signal, pause other heavy internet activity, restart the Fire TV Stick and router, and test with Ethernet if supported. The source service and device performance can also affect playback.

How do I fix “No Signal” on my television?

Check the TV's selected HDMI input, confirm the streaming device is powered and connected, and test another HDMI port if available. “No Signal” on the TV does not always mean the broadband connection is down.

Can I install an Android APK on a Samsung or LG Smart TV?

Usually, Android APK files are not designed for Samsung Tizen or LG webOS. Check the television's official app store and the app developer's compatibility information.

Why does my app work on Wi-Fi but not on another connection?

Different networks can have different signal quality, security settings, connectivity and provider policies. Check the network connection and consult the relevant app or internet provider if access is restricted or an error appears. Do not attempt to bypass network restrictions.

Should I clear app cache or clear app data?

Try clearing the cache first where the device offers that option. Clearing app data can remove saved settings and sign you out, so make sure you have the correct setup information before doing so.

What time should I use when reporting an issue?

Please include the date and approximate time in UK local time (GMT or BST, depending on the season) so support can identify the relevant event more easily.

Does GTV ULTRA guarantee that every app works on every device?

No. App availability and compatibility depend on the app publisher, device model, operating system and region. Check the official app listing and publisher guidance before installing.

How can I check the progress of a support request?

Use the ticket number and the same email address you entered when submitting your request in the Customer Portal.

03 / Fire TV Stick

Set up your Fire TV Stick

Follow these steps to install one of the supported apps using Downloader.

Part A — Install Downloader

  1. From the Fire TV home screen, open Find or Search.
  2. Search for Downloader by AFTVnews.
  3. Select the app and choose Download / Get.
  4. Open Downloader and allow the requested file access permission.

Part B — Install your app

  1. In Downloader, select the URL / code input field.
  2. Enter the required code from the App Downloads section.
  3. Select Go and wait for the download to finish.
  4. Select Install, then Open when complete.

If installation is blocked

  1. Open Fire TV Settings.
  2. Go to My Fire TV → About and select your device name several times if Developer Options are hidden.
  3. Return to Developer Options → Install unknown apps.
  4. Allow Downloader only when you trust the app and its source.

Open and set up the player

  1. Launch the installed app from Your Apps & Channels.
  2. Choose the login method supplied by your authorised service provider.
  3. Enter your own account details carefully.
  4. Wait for the app to load, then test playback.
Fire TV menu names can vary by model and software version. Do not enable unknown-app installation for apps or files you do not trust.
04 / Smart TV

Set up your Smart TV

For Samsung and LG televisions, use the TV’s own app store whenever the player is available there.

Samsung Smart TV

  1. Connect your TV to the internet.
  2. Press the Home button on your remote.
  3. Open Apps and select Search.
  4. Search for IBO Player or a supported Smarters player.
  5. Check the app publisher, install, and open it.

LG Smart TV

  1. Connect your TV to the internet.
  2. Press Home and open the LG Content Store or Apps.
  3. Search for IBO Player or a supported media player.
  4. Select the app and choose Install.
  5. Open the app and follow its on-screen setup.

Android TV / Google TV

  1. Open the Google Play Store.
  2. Search for a compatible player app.
  3. Select Install and wait for it to finish.
  4. If using Downloader, enter the relevant app code from this page.
  5. Open the app and follow the setup instructions.

IBO Player setup

  1. Install IBO Player from a trusted source or your TV’s app store.
  2. Open the app and note the device information shown on screen.
  3. Follow the app’s official activation instructions.
  4. Use only playlist or account details you are authorised to access.
Not every Samsung or LG TV supports every player. App names and availability can vary by model, operating system and country. If an app is unavailable, choose a compatible alternative.
